FileManagerHint: Choose the application used to open instances, com.mojang, content and logs. This does not change your system default. Install missing applications through your distribution.
ContentExperimentalNotice: Managing and importing textures, addons and maps (worlds) are experimental features. They may cause bugs or not work correctly. Back up your worlds and content before making changes.
MangoHudIntro: Performance overlay for this instance. Uses the MangoHud installed on your system with the game's Vulkan renderer (DXVK/VKD3D). Nothing is installed automatically.
MangoHudEnable: Enable automatically when MangoHud is installed
MangoHudFound: MangoHud detected in the launcher's PATH. Availability is checked again when starting the game.
MangoHudMissing: MangoHud was not found in the launcher's PATH. You can save these preferences now; the game will start normally without the automatic overlay.
MangoHudHint: Only affects this instance's game launch. Metrics override global MangoHud configuration and advanced MANGOHUD_CONFIG while automatic integration is enabled. Disable it to use your own wrapper/environment settings. Temperatures require the respective CPU/GPU panel; sensors depend on your hardware and drivers. Gamescope requires its own mangoapp setup. No FPS limit or automatic logging is enabled.
ContentStorageHint: GDK stores shared addons/textures and each profile's worlds in separate com.mojang folders. Choose the location you need.
ContentStorageMissing: No instance content storage was found.
RtxExperimentalNotice: This entire RTX area is experimental, for both BetterRTX and Vanilla RTX. Community activity and updates can be sparse, with limited documentation, especially for newer Minecraft versions. To suggest improvements or bug fixes, contact yPerfectBR on Discord or open an issue on the project's GitHub.
RtxAcceptNewerRisk: I understand the risks of using this BetterRTX preset on a newer Minecraft version. It may cause crashes, broken textures or rendering errors. Allow installation and launch only for this preset and the selected instance version.
RtxImportVersionHint: The archive must declare a matching Minecraft target in orion-preset.json (gameVersion). Unknown and mismatched targets cannot be installed.
RtxRawBlocked: Raw material files have no declared Minecraft target. Import is blocked; use a versioned preset or an Orion export containing target metadata.
RtxInstalledBlocked: The installed BetterRTX preset needs compatibility review. For a newer game, select the preset, acknowledge the risks and reinstall it. Otherwise choose a matching preset or restore original shaders.
RtxTargetDeclared: Minecraft target declared by the source, if available; not an in-game validation. Matching version labels do not guarantee compatibility.
RtxTargetInferred: Minecraft target inferred from the three published shader URLs, not an in-game validation. The BetterRTX number in the name describes the preset's shader base.
RtxCompatibilityNotice: BetterRTX compatibility · Minecraft 26.30 atlas warning and version limits
RtxFamilyConflict: The other RTX system has resources or active preferences in this instance. Installing or configuring this system is blocked until those are restored, archived/unlinked and reset. Existing files are preserved; use a separate instance to keep both systems.
ClearLogConfirm: Erase this instance's journal? This cannot be undone. New output will continue to appear; game files and crash dumps are preserved.
ClearAllLogsConfirm: Erase all instance and launcher .log journals? This cannot be undone. Game data and original game crash reports are not removed. Running sessions will continue logging.
RtxFamiliesHint: One RTX system per instance. To switch, restore shaders or archive/unlink packs, restore any replaced DLSS DLL, and reset that system's preferences.
RtxBetterNotice: 16 June 2026: BetterRTX maintainers warned that Minecraft 26.30 changed the texture atlas, breaking existing presets, and recommended restoring Mojang's RTX. The public presets repository subsequently changed binary links on 20 June and corrected presets on 22 June. This is not proof that every preset works on later releases. Newer Minecraft versions require explicit risk acknowledgement; older or unknown targets remain blocked. Preset names such as BetterRTX 1.3 are not Minecraft compatibility versions.
RtxVanillaHint: Vanilla RTX resource packs and their launch preferences. Uses Minecraft's original RTX shaders; BetterRTX is managed separately.
CfCollectionHint: Find your next adventure. Select a project to explore its files and installation options.
RtxIntro: Shape the light. Discover shaders, install RTX textures and personalize each instance.
RtxCreatorNativeHint: Customize BetterRTX inside Orion using the official versioned settings. Labels and descriptions come from BetterRTX. Compilation uses their online service; browsing, installation and recovery run in Orion. No website code is executed locally.
RtxCreatorReplace: This replaces the current editor values with the selected version's defaults. No installed instance will change.
RtxCreatorBuildHint: Send only these shader settings to the official BetterRTX compilation service? This does not install anything. Review the resulting preset and confirm its destinations afterward. Authentication or anti-bot checks may require using the official creator; Orion cannot bypass them.
RtxCreatorServiceNotice: Online compilation may require BetterRTX authentication or anti-bot verification, unavailable in this native editor. Catalog presets and versioned .rtpack files can be installed without a browser, subject to game-version compatibility checks.
RtxBatchSummary: Completed: {0} of {1} instances. See individual results.
RtxBatchCompatibility: Only the selected instance will change. Newer game versions require the risk checkbox; older and unknown targets remain blocked.
RtxSafeRecoveryHint: Restore original shader paths or the original DLSS backup. Modified or unverified files are preserved under the instance's rtx/quarantine or rtx/dlss folder. Ambiguous external redirects and damaged original backups are never overwritten.
RtxAdvancedVideo: Show advanced video settings in Minecraft
RtxExportHint: Export this instance's current or original shaders as .rtpack to an external folder. Existing files are never overwritten. Keep original-game backups private; DLLs are not included.
RtxCreatorLinksHint: Use the integrated shader editor or load a brtx://creator/HASH or brtx://preset/ID link to preview a preset. Installation requires a declared, matching game target. Legacy creator links may expire; local .rtpack imports require target metadata. Raw material imports are blocked.
RtxLinkReady: RTX content ready to review. Choose destinations before installing.
RtxProtocolHint: Register Orion RTX Studio for brtx:// links in your user application menu. Your existing default handler is not replaced. Choose Orion when your browser or desktop asks which application to use. No administrator access is required.
RtxDlssOriginal: Original game DLSS / no Orion replacement
RtxDlssWarning: Optional executable-code replacement: only install DLLs you trust. Downloads come from an immutable commit of NVIDIA's official DLSS repository; local files are not publisher-authenticated. Orion checks Windows x64 DLL format and keeps a verified original backup. Requires an existing nvngx_dlss.dll and compatible NVIDIA hardware, drivers and runtime. It does not enable DLSS on unsupported systems or install drivers. NVIDIA's license applies.
RtxTextureInstalledHint: Installed version shown above. Manage or archive this pack in Content before replacing it; shared packs are managed in the shared library.
RtxSetupHint: Orion performs the GDK setup automatically: compiled materials go into a separate managed folder and materials.index.json redirects the RTX slots there. Original shaders are never overwritten. Known target versions are required; newer games need explicit risk acknowledgement.
RtxVerified: State refreshed. Managed shader paths and file hashes checked. Rendering compatibility still depends on the game, GPU and driver.
RtxVerificationFailed: The RTX setup could not be verified. Refresh its state and resolve external changes before replacing or restoring shaders.
RtxChooseInstance: Create or select an instance to install and configure RTX. You can still browse without one.
RtxEmptyHint: Refresh the catalog or try another search. Presets come directly from BetterRTX.
RtxCached: Offline catalog: showing the last successful result. Installation still needs a connection.
RtxCompatibilityMatching: Exact advertised Minecraft target match. This does not prove the shader was rebuilt correctly or tested with your game, GPU and runtime.
RtxCompatibilityNewerGame: This instance is newer than the preset's advertised target. Compatibility is not guaranteed. Check the risk acknowledgement below to enable installation; restoring Minecraft's original shaders remains the safer option.
RtxCompatibilityOlderGame: Blocked: this instance is older than the preset's advertised target. Choose a preset for this exact Minecraft version.
RtxCompatibilityUnknown: Blocked: no unambiguous target Minecraft version is available. Orion will not install unverified shader targets.
RtxInstallWarning: Close the game first. Orion preserves the original shader binaries and can restore their index paths. Third-party shaders may be incompatible with your game, GPU or driver.
RtxTextureHint: Latest Vanilla RTX releases by Cubeir. Packs install into this instance's user resource packs, never the game's built-in packs. Enable the pack in Minecraft. Manage or archive it in Content; archive an existing version before replacing it.
RtxTextureInstalled: Texture installed. Enable it in Minecraft; manage it in Content.
RtxForceLaunch: Request ray-traced graphics when starting this instance
RtxLaunchHint: Off by default. Applies to existing in-game profiles on the next launch. Start and sign into Minecraft once if no profiles exist. Turning this off stops enforcing the options; it does not change the last settings saved by Minecraft.
RtxRestoreHint: Removes only Orion's installed shader preset and restores its original material paths. Texture packs, worlds and launch preferences are kept. External shader modifications must be resolved before restoring.
RtxRequirementsHint: Ray tracing needs a compatible GPU, driver and WineGDK runtime, plus an RTX resource pack or world. Installing a preset does not add hardware support. Custom presets need declared target metadata matching the instance. No proprietary GPU runtime is bundled.
RtxCancelled: Cancelled. Temporary download files were cleaned up.
RtxFailed: RTX operation failed. See the details above.
RtxInstalled: Shader preset installed. Start the instance when ready.
RtxSettingsSaved: RTX preferences saved for this instance.
WallpaperRotationHint: Automatic rotation is optional. With it off, the wallpaper changes only when you press Next image or reopen Orion. Random order never repeats the current image immediately.
CfBrowseIntro: Discover Minecraft Bedrock addons, maps and textures. Choose where to install, without opening an instance.
CfDiscoverHint: Choose a content type, enter a search or browse with an empty search.
CfSelectProjectHint: Select a result to view its description, files and installation destinations.
CfSharedHint: Save only to Content's shared library. Nothing is installed into instances automatically. Add content to one chosen instance at a time from Content.
CfNoInstances: No instances yet. You can still save files to the shared library.
CfDestinationUnavailable: A selected instance is unavailable. Refresh destinations and try again.
CfSavedDistributionFailed: Saved to Content, but distribution did not finish. Open the shared library to retry; no need to download again.
SettingsAutoSave: Changes are applied and saved automatically.
SettingsSaveFailed: Could not save settings. Check permissions and try again.
ContentLibraryHint: Import addons, textures and worlds. Manage one instance at a time.
ContentLinkHint: Packs have one shared source. User-content folders are prepared automatically; vanilla game files are untouched. Changes to a shared source affect every linked instance.
ContentNeedsProfile: Addon and texture folders are ready. To import worlds, start and sign into this instance once so Minecraft can create its storage profile.
ContentLibraryEmptyHint: Import a .mcaddon, .mcpack or .mcworld, then choose one instance to receive it.
ContentNoMatchesHint: Try another name or clear the filters to see your library.
ContentCopyWorldHint: Worlds are independent copies, never links. Choose one instance and its existing in-game storage profile. Importing again creates another copy.
ContentLocalHint: Inspect installed packs and worlds, export or archive local content, and browse CurseForge for each instance. Shared library sources are kept when their links are removed.
ContentSharedPack: Shared library · manage links from Content
SolarHint: Enter your approximate coordinates. Solar elevation is calculated locally; no location is sent online. Default 0°, 0° is the equator, not your detected location.
KeepWindowOpaque: Keep Orion opaque on the desktop
KeepWindowOpaqueHint: Off by default. Forced desktop transparency requires an Orion-only exception. You will be asked before any supported configuration change; turning this off removes the exception created by Orion. Internal wallpaper transparency is unchanged.
DesktopOpacityLimit: The launcher already draws an opaque base. There is no universal way to override forced compositor transparency. Umbriel supports a validated, reversible rule with your permission. Other desktops show instructions and leave the switch off. No compositor is restarted and no administrator password is requested.
DesktopRuleRequired: Add OrionLauncher as an exception to your desktop's transparency rules. Automatic configuration is not available for this environment; the switch remains off.
DesktopRuleConsent: Umbriel's forced opacity cannot be overridden by the X11 request. Add an exception matching only OrionLauncher to the DEFAULT config below? Confirm this is the config used by your session. Orion will validate it, keep a backup and preserve all other settings. This uses Umbriel's automatic config reload. No sudo is needed.
DesktopRuleUndoConsent: Remove only the unchanged exception created by Orion from this file? Your other rules and subsequent edits will be preserved; a backup is kept.
DesktopRuleApplied: Exception saved and validated. Umbriel reloads its configuration automatically. This does not change other applications.
DesktopRuleRemoved: Orion's exception was removed. Your desktop's normal rules apply again.
DesktopRuleFailed: Could not safely change the rule. Check file permissions, custom config paths or an edited managed block. Use the manual instructions; do not run the launcher as root.
DesktopRuleGnome: In GNOME-based desktops (including Zorin OS and older Pop!_OS sessions), find the extension or effect that applies whole-window transparency and exclude the application OrionLauncher. There is no universal GNOME extension setting; Orion will not disable extensions or edit arbitrary schemas.
DesktopRuleCosmic: In COSMIC / Pop!_OS, check which compositor effect or custom configuration is applying transparency and exclude OrionLauncher. GNOME extension instructions do not apply to COSMIC. Automatic configuration is not available.
MonitorResolutionHint: Choose a monitor's current pixel dimensions to fill and lock width and height. Select Manual dimensions to edit them. Disconnected monitor dimensions remain saved. Resolution is still a preference for future native integration.
DesktopRuleLast: Add this rule after other opacity rules in your compositor configuration. It matches only Orion windows, not Minecraft. Remove the rule to restore desktop policy (the launcher switch cannot remove a rule you added manually).
DesktopRuleHyprland: Create a window rule matching exactly the class OrionLauncher, with opaque enabled and opacity set to 1.0 for active, inactive and fullscreen windows. Use the rule syntax supported by your Hyprland version. Remove that rule to restore desktop policy. Documentation: https://wiki.hypr.land/configuring/core/rules/window-rules/
DesktopRuleKde: In KDE System Settings → Window Management → Window Rules, detect an Orion window or match its class OrionLauncher. Set Active opacity and Inactive opacity to 100%, with Force. Match the application class, not a title, to cover dialogs and logs too. Remove the rule to restore desktop policy.
DesktopRuleOther: In your compositor's window rules, match only the application class OrionLauncher and set active and inactive opacity to 100%. Some compositors require an exception to a global transparency effect. Remove the exception to restore desktop policy.
ModeCustomizationHint: 49 additional hues and custom colors. Each mode remembers its own accent, base and material. Editing a profile does not change the active display mode.
InvalidHex: Use a color in #RRGGBB format before saving.
MaterialHint: Applies to panels, menus, inputs and internal windows. Readability protection overrides low opacity: panels stay at least 96% opaque and the wallpaper veil at least 88%. Turn it off to use the full slider range. Diffusion affects the wallpaper, never the text. Base tint strength only applies to accent or custom bases.
WallpaperHint: Choose a fixed local image or a folder, with optional timed rotation. Images are loaded on demand, up to 1920 pixels; no gallery remains in memory. At most 2,000 entries are scanned, without subfolders. GIF uses its first frame.
WallpaperEmpty: No supported images in this folder.
WallpaperFailed: Cannot load this image or folder. Check permissions, or choose another image (up to 32 MB and 40 megapixels).
CfManualHint: The author requires a download from the CurseForge website. Download this version in your browser and save it in the folder below. Orion will detect, verify and import it automatically.
CfManualPreserve: Only this folder is checked, without subfolders. Your original download stays untouched. You can change the folder or cancel at any time.
CfManualMissingFolder: This folder does not exist. Choose the folder used by your browser.
CfManualUnreadableFolder: Unable to read the download. Check permissions or choose another folder.
CfManualVerifying: Verifying the file and preparing a safe copy…
CfManualMismatch: A file was found, but its hash does not match this version. Waiting for the correct download…
CfManualBrowserFailed: Could not open the browser. Try again or copy the page address below; Orion is still watching the folder.
ContentOverview: Your worlds and packs, organized per instance. Import local content or discover projects on CurseForge.
ContentEmptyHint: Import a .mcworld, .mcpack or .mcaddon. Start and sign into this instance once to create its game storage profiles.
ContentArchiveHint: Move this item out of the game? Its files will stay in this instance's archive and can be restored. Worlds using this pack may report it missing until restored.
ContentSafetyHint: Stop the game before managing files. Packs are shared within this instance; worlds belong to an in-game storage profile (not a launcher account ID). Enable imported packs in Minecraft's world settings.
CfIntro: Find Minecraft Bedrock addons, maps and textures on CurseForge. Search within a content type, then choose a project and file to install into this instance.
CfNoCategories: CurseForge returned no supported content types. Try searching again.
CfInstallHint: Install only content you trust. Check the listed game versions yourself; compatibility is not guaranteed. Addon dependencies are not installed automatically. The world profile is only required for .mcworld files.
CfUnsupported: This file is not a .mcworld, .mcpack or .mcaddon. Visit the project's page for its installation instructions.
CfUnavailable: CurseForge is not configured. Use an official build or supply your own key through CURSEFORGE_API_KEY or ORION_CURSEFORGE_API_KEY_FILE, then restart Orion. Local file import remains available.
SettingsSubtitle: Your launcher, your preferences. Everything in one place.
VisualThemeHint: Changes the entire interface: backgrounds, panels, fields and menus. Each theme includes a light and a dark version.
ThemeHint: Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically. Complete custom colors in #RRGGBB format.
ThemeSystemHint: Follow system uses the light or dark preference reported by your desktop.
ThemePaletteHint: Match theme uses its recommended accent. Or choose your own color for buttons, selections and progress without changing the backgrounds.
InstanceShortcutHint: Optional · off by default. Adds only this instance to the Linux application menu. Disabling it removes the shortcut, not the game.
StopToEdit: The game is running. Stop it to edit settings; logs and files are still available.
SettingsLogHint: Follow live output in a separate window without losing your pending settings.
InstanceFilesHint: Open this instance's folder in your file manager.
CoverHint: Optional Minecraft covers. Choosing an image downloads a small thumbnail; it is cached for offline use and shared between cards. Color and initial uses no cover downloads or image memory.
CoverCredit: Images: Xbox México, via Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 3.0. Resized and cropped for the cards.
ChangelogHint: Release notes bundled with this build, available offline. Current release notes are in English.
LegacyChangelogWarning: Historical release notes. These features are not necessarily available in the current version.
InstanceAccountHint: Used when starting the game. Does not change the launcher's current account.
CopyLogHint: Copy the recent output shown here
DownloadsHint: Installations run in the background. Interrupted work resumes when Orion opens again.
ResizeLog: Drag to resize the log. The first row of instances stays visible.
LaunchCommandHint: Default: %command%. Example: prime-run %command% (requires prime-run installed). This wraps the launch and preserves game arguments and environment variables. Quotes are supported; shell operators and variable expansion are not.
ShowLogOnLaunch: Open the instance log when playing
LogHint: Installation · prefix · Xodus · game. Recent output shown here; full history saved on disk.
LogReadError: Unable to read this log right now. Retrying…
AccountsUnknown: Unlock the keyring and refresh to load saved accounts.
AccountsUpdateRequired: Refresh to update Xodus and load your saved accounts.
RemoveAccountHint: Remove this account from Orion only? Installed games are kept. If this is the active account, the next saved account becomes active.
AccountsHint: Accounts and credentials stay in Orion's private Xodus profile. The active account is used for Xbox services; any saved account that purchased Minecraft for PC can authorize an installation. Your desktop may ask you to unlock its keyring.
GameArgumentsHint: One argument per line, without enclosing quotes. Values with spaces stay on one line. These are game arguments, not shell commands.
EnvironmentHint: One NAME=value per line. Applied only to this game's launch; account, socket and prefix settings are protected. Stored in instance.json: do not enter passwords or tokens.
ResolutionHint: Not implemented yet. These preferences are saved for future use but do not change the game's resolution, fullscreen mode or launch behavior.
LibrarySubtitle: A home for every world you create.
UnaffiliatedNotice: Orion Launcher is not affiliated with or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
EmptyText: Sign in with Microsoft, then create your first Bedrock instance.
Name: Instance name
AccountText: Sign in through Xodus with an account that purchased Minecraft for Windows. Accounts stay in Orion's private profile. If needed, the system will ask you to create or unlock its password keyring.
Background: Keep running when the window closes
Shortcuts: Show instances in the Linux application menu
RuntimeText: Orion checks the latest stable Xodus and WineGDK releases before use. Previously installed runtimes are retained for recovery.
AboutText: A fresh start for Minecraft Bedrock on Linux. Built around independent instances, a private Xodus profile, and WineGDK.
History: Legacy changelogs are preserved in docs/en_US/changelog/legacy.
ArchiveText: The game and its saves will be moved to Orion's archives folder. You can restore them later. Its application menu entry will be removed.
CatalogOffline: Showing cached versions; the catalog could not be refreshed.
ExitText: Downloads will pause and resume next time. Running games will be stopped. Save your world first.
RuntimeBusy: Close all game instances before updating runtimes.
InstallHint: A valid Minecraft for Windows license is required. Use the Account tab to sign in first.
